DIV8.HEAD: § 365.115 After publication in the FMCSA Register.
DIV8.P: (a) Interested persons have 10 days from the date of FMCSA Register publication to file protests. See Subpart B of this part.
(b) If no one opposes the application, the grant published in the FMCSA Register will become effective by issuance of a certificate, permit, or license.
